title: Team CLI-spawn tests time out under full-suite load on a slow Windows host
observation: After the Windows cluster fix (fnd_d78bb24c20 resolved), 3 team tests still fail ONLY under full-suite parallel load: 'a CLI command refuses all handlers when its route changes during the startup pull' (60s timeout), 'strict team route rejects origin push refspec before Git transport' (101s), 'MCP refuses an existing shared overlay whose remote differs from committed team.json' (102s). Each spawns the CLI via tsx repeatedly; under the full suite (team-matrix runs 3 MCP servers concurrently) spawnSync hits ETIMEDOUT on this host. All three pass when their file runs alone (team-route-contract 25/25, MCP overlay test green solo). Load starvation, not logic.
evidence: solo runs same day: team-route-contract.test.ts 25/25; team-final-closure.test.ts 10/10
suite1/2 comparison: 109 -> 14 -> 3 fails as real causes were fixed
